Enterprise Features

Everything You Need for Enterprise QR Orchestration

Built from the ground up for high-volume enterprise traffic, marketing campaigns, product packaging, and secure internal operations.

Dynamic Route Swapping

Change destination links anytime after printing billboards, brochures, or packaging. Avoid costly reprints and broken campaigns with instant zero-downtime routing.

Real-Time Scan Telemetry

Gain granular intelligence on scans by location, operating system, device family, time of day, and custom UTM campaign tags to optimize marketing ROI.

Bespoke Brand Styling

Embed brand logos, customize eye patterns, choose custom color palettes, and apply curved or dot-matrix body styles that match your company's visual identity.

Commercial Vector Exports

Download crisp, non-rasterized vector assets in SVG, EPS, and PDF with CYMK color compatibility ready for large-format offset printing presses.

High-Throughput REST API

Programmatically generate thousands of customized QR codes per minute using simple JSON payloads with webhooks and automated batch archiving.

GDPR & Enterprise Security

Full compliance with global data privacy regulations, IP hashing, TLS 1.3 encryption, and custom password-protected QR links for confidential documents.

Architecture Comparison

Static vs. Dynamic QR Codes

Understand how Coralgenz Dynamic QR architecture empowers agility and prevents costly logistical errors.

Coralgenz Dynamic Edge Routing Lifecycle

Every scan executes at the nearest cloud edge node in under 15 milliseconds.

STEP 01

User Scans Code

Camera lens detects QR matrix and opens short-link domain seamlessly.

STEP 02

Edge Resolution

Coralgenz edge proxy validates destination and applies geo-routing rules.

STEP 03

Telemetry Logging

Anonymous scan metadata, device specs, and UTM parameters recorded asynchronously.

STEP 04

Instant Redirection

User lands on target web application, menu, vCard, or payment portal.

Frequently Asked Questions

Got Questions? We Have Answers

Everything you need to know about dynamic QR codes, print vector resolutions, analytics, and security.

Static QR codes encode fixed text or URLs directly into the pixel grid. Once generated or printed on physical media, they can never be modified. Dynamic QR codes route through Coralgenz's high-speed edge proxy, enabling you to change target destination URLs anytime, even after printing thousands of flyers or billboards, while capturing real-time scan analytics.
No. Unlike generic third-party tools that deactivate your QR codes after 14 days to force a subscription, Coralgenz QR provides unlimited lifetime scans and non-expiring dynamic routing.
Yes! Coralgenz QR generates 100% scalable vector formats (SVG and PDF). You can resize them to any scale—from a 1-inch business card to a 50-foot highway billboard—with zero pixelation or loss of clarity.
Our real-time telemetry dashboard tracks total scans, unique visitors, exact scan timestamps, country/city geolocation, device categories (iOS vs Android), browser types, and custom UTM referral campaign metrics.
Yes. You can upload custom high-resolution PNG or SVG logos to center in the QR code, customize eye shapes, pick custom gradient or hex accent colors, and adjust error correction levels (up to 30% damage resistance).
Coralgenz routes dynamic QR requests across global edge CDN servers with sub-15ms DNS and HTTP resolution latency, ensuring instant load times with zero noticeable delay for end users.
